en: A pack of classes to play, and nothing to play them in.
One line on how it plays.
One line on what it does.
One line on where they come from.
One line on what they did before this.
That is a real one. Careful now.
No. I do not like that.
There. That is the top of it.
Every one of them. Look at that.
Hold on. That one is not sitting straight.
Somebody here is waiting on you.
Go on, then. I am watching.
You are spending. You always spend.
I hate it when they roll and do not say.
Ask again and I will only say it louder.
Put the thing down. All the way down.
